title: Provider auth core: inbound ProviderAuthenticator, outbound ProviderCredential, per-peer policy with enforce/observe, and mechanism 4 (manual trust lists)
description: Step 1 of mimid-75nk. Trait for inbound authentication (request + TLS info -> AuthenticatedProvider {domain, mechanism, key/cert id} or refusal), outbound credential (signing / client cert), per-deployment ordered list of accepted mechanisms with per-peer overrides, enforce by default and per-peer observe (log + accept). Authenticated domain must equal From and, for /notify, the room's hub. One DEBUG disposition event per refusal. Mechanism 4: configured peer keys, CAs or certificates per peer domain. Update decision mimid-1wgh.17, AGENTS.md known weaknesses, main.rs # Limitations, README.
